description: Performs recurring HTTPS-based C2-style check-ins to a controlled lab server, retrieves benign command strings, processes supported lab commands, and submits command results back to the server. The sample uses a dedicated beacon thread, periodic sleep intervals, JSON-style API endpoints, and controlled command handling for noop, ping, and sleep commands.

beacon_client.role: initializes a C2 client, tests HTTPS connectivity, creates a beacon thread, polls for benign commands, processes supported commands, and sends results back to the controlled server

c2_client_library.role: encapsulates HTTPS communication, check-in requests, result submission, beacon interval tracking, and client running state

server_responses.role: static INetSim HTTPS fakefile responses for connectivity testing, command polling, and result acknowledgement

c2_client: WinHTTP or HTTPS client request APIs

beacon_behavior.description: The sample initializes an HTTPS C2 client, tests connectivity, starts a dedicated beacon thread, sends recurring check-ins, parses returned command strings, executes only benign lab-safe command handlers, posts results to the controlled server, and sleeps for the configured interval before repeating.
expected_actions: create dedicated beacon thread using CreateThread
receive zero or more command strings from the server
send CHECKIN_OK result when no task is returned
parse command strings using pipe-delimited command and argument format
handle noop command by returning SUCCESS|NOOP
handle ping command by returning SUCCESS|PONG
handle sleep command by updating beacon interval
clamp sleep command argument between 5 and 300 seconds
ignore unsupported commands with benign ignored status
retry after 30 seconds if an exception occurs during beacon cycle

command_behavior.description: The command handling logic is intentionally limited to benign lab commands and does not execute arbitrary operating system commands.

command_behavior.unsupported_command_behavior: returns IGNORED|Unsupported benign lab command and does not execute the command
